MathJax 3.2.2 (mathjax-full)
https://github.com/mathjax/MathJax-src

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (see mathjax-LICENSE.txt).

The application bundles MathJax's TeX input, selected local TeX extensions, SVG
output and default TeX glyph data in its lazy math image module. Application
adapters rebuild generated SVG before exporting PNG. No MathJax code is modified.
